text:
akash: Heads-up — I’m seeing a 2.3x p95 regression on the seqlen=256-512 traffic after yesterday's kernel-choice change. Only on sm86 nodes so far.

maria: Ugh. Any idea which kernel path is getting chosen? repro script?

akash: Quick dump from a failing run below. Looks like seqlen gating misclassified the hardware capabilities and routed to `matmul_generic` instead of `sm86_fused_tc_bf16`. KV cache hit rates are normal.

ben: Can you paste the exact command you used to reproduce? Also which model/quantization?

akash: Repro command:
```
./perf_runner --model redwood-lite-1 --quant bf16 --batch 4 --seqlen 384 --target-gpu sm86 --warmup 100 --measure 1000
```
Kernel log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-16T21:12:03Z] HW_SIG: sm86 cap_mask=0x13 tc=1 bf16=1 fp8=0
[2026-03-16T21:12:03Z] KERNEL_SELECT: seqlen=384 heur=seqlen_gating -> pick=matmul_generic (score=0.72)
[2026-03-16T21:12:03Z] FALLBACK: reason=cap_probe_mismatch -> chosen=matmul_generic
```

maria: Thanks. That `cap_probe_mismatch` line is interesting — suggests the capability flags probe returned something different during startup. Could be race in the probe cache if multiple contexts probed concurrently.

runtime-bot: perf-profile uploaded: https://internal.redwood/profiles/2165432100. Summary: p50 ~ same, p95 increased 2.3x, tail increased mostly during first 300 tokens. Hotspots: kernel matmul_generic (50% extra time), kernel selection checks (10%).

liang: Two quick possibilities: 1) the hw probe uses a transient driver flag that flips during init, 2) the seqlen gating threshold logic got adjusted (new heuristic) and now maps 384 -> generic path. I pushed a small debug branch that logs probe order: https://git/repo/branches/diag/seqlen-probe-order

ben: Also check KV cache interaction — if a request hits before KV cache is warmed/attached, some code paths mark `force_generic=true`. The logs above show `KV_CACHE: warm=false` for one of the slow traces.

akash: Good catch — here’s the trace around the slow request:
```
REQUEST_ID=0x7f1a
KV_CACHE: attached=false
SEQLEN_GATING: decision=generic_reason=kv_attach_pending
KERNEL_EXEC: matmul_generic time=12.3ms
```
So it chose generic because KV cache wasn't attached yet. But that shouldn't persist for the whole session.

maria: Do we have repro that keeps KV attach failing? What does infra show for the attach latency on sm86?

liang: Infra metrics: last deploy introduced a small change in the attach retry backoff. For some containers attach latency jumped from ~8ms to ~120ms under light load. If the gating check runs during that window, it will route to the conservative kernel.

ben: Proposed short-term mitigation: change seqlen gating to consult a sticky capability flag per-worker (persist probe result for N minutes) so transient attach hiccups don't flip the kernel. Longer term: make KV attach blocking for first request or pre-attach during init.

akash: I can test the sticky flag patch locally. If that reduces p95 in the profile I’ll open a PR.

maria: Please include a unit test for the sticky behavior and a small perf harness to demonstrate p95 improvement. Also add a log marker when fallback happens: `FALLBACK: sticky_override=true` so we can audit historical incidents.

runtime-bot: Action created: INC-2026-89 (investigate seqlen gating misroute). Assigned to @akash and @liang.

liang: Quick experiment results (local): sticky probe for 10m -> p95 reduced from 182ms to 83ms on sm86 for the 384 seqlen test. Will prepare a PR with the opt-in flag.

ben: Nice. Once PR is up, let's run a small canary on dedicated pool and watch token-level tracing for first-request KV attach latency.

akash: Opening PR now: https://git/repo/pulls/4021 - includes patch, unit tests, perf harness, and a dashboard link.

maria: Great. Please add a runbook entry: how to revert sticky behavior and how to force re-probe if hardware config changes.

akash: Will do. Thanks everyone :pray: 

liang: Follow-up: I’ll also add a guard so that if `hw_sig` changes (firmware/drivers update), worker forces re-probe immediately.

maria: Sounds good. Marking this thread resolved once PR is merged and canary passes.

akash: Closing loop: PR merged, canary looked good overnight. I’ll post final numbers tomorrow and close INC-2026-89. :white_check_mark:
